g.text: Eye Trace ? hardware measurement datums (schematic, not to scale)
Camera front: nominal hole centers only; measure outer edges, holes and lens separately
Measure: each hole diameter; edge offsets; PCB W/H
Also measure width, ear underside height/thickness,
hole diameters, output axis from case end, wire exit.
Original horn and camera side checks
Trace BOTH horn outlines with scale: arm count/angles/tips, web thickness, hub height.
Measure seated horn height and factory screw head/access; do not invent spline teeth.
Measure PCB rear components around all four standoffs and screw ends before plate printing.
Record actual cable width/thickness, connector, exit and bend radius; test slack over full sweep.
UNVERIFIED physical fit. Use coupon results and physical_results.csv; never force factory holes.
